copy.aboutTeaser: I'm Devyn, an underwater macro photographer who spends as much time as possible below the surface. My favorite subjects are the small ones: seahorses the size of a fingernail, frogfish pretending to be sponges, and everything else weird, cute, or hard to find.
copy.aboutLong: I learned to dive in 2008 and instantly fell in love. Not long after, I moved abroad for my divemaster internship and ended up working as a dive guide in Borneo, where my passion for macro life began. Eventually I returned home to finish my degree, and these days I coach competitive gymnastics for a living, but diving has never stopped being my biggest passion.
